title: kesoCraft
description: Change all the textures in Minecraft to make it look like an RPG game.
body:
Tired of seeing the same old default Minecraft textures?

# Introducing KesoCraft!
-------------------------

> **KesoCraft is a texture pack that completely changes the way Minecraft looks, modifying most textures to resemble an RPG.**
> 
> **If you like RPG-style games or their graphics, this texture pack is for you.**

_(Currently in beta, some items, most blocks, and some interfaces are missing. Don't expect it to be 100% polished.)_



If you want to stay updated on the pack, find me as Kesosecooficial on TikTok.
